persisted_records.sensitivity: plaintext gateway secrets and config
persisted_records.observed_current: Rust and Python discover host gateway variables here and copy selected prefixes to profiles.
persisted_records.target_contract: Only retained profile keys may produce child/profile/network state; removed keys stay readable solely for explicit inventory/export/cleanup.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: user-confirmed key-level rewrite with backup; never recursively delete the home
known_gaps: Removed keys can currently affect eligibility, profile migration and web-child host expansion.

persisted_records.sensitivity: plaintext profile-scoped gateway secrets
persisted_records.observed_current: Rust creates per-platform profile directories and copies prefix-selected host values.
persisted_records.target_contract: Only six retained external platform ids may receive new profile files, isolated by mainland_cn/sea.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: explicit per-platform export/clear; no automatic recursive directory deletion
known_gaps: Current prefix registry contains removed platforms and Email copies SMS_/TWILIO_.

persisted_records.sensitivity: non-secret model/user preferences plus possible platform config
persisted_records.observed_current: Rust seeds each child from host config and preferences.
persisted_records.target_contract: Only retained profiles are produced; profile-local values cannot widen another profile.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: retain for supported profiles; removed profiles require explicit user cleanup
known_gaps: SEA currently reuses mainland autostart selection.

persisted_records.sensitivity: platform config, allowlists, home targets and non-secret agent preferences
persisted_records.observed_current: config.yaml wins over gateway.json; both can describe removed platforms.
persisted_records.target_contract: New writes reject removed/unknown platform sections; legacy values remain listable/exportable until explicit cleanup.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: key-level compatibility reader and explicit cleanup; never reinterpret removed ids
known_gaps: Dynamic plugin registration can currently make an unknown config platform live.

persisted_records.sensitivity: recipient ids and scheduled message metadata
persisted_records.observed_current: Jobs may contain retained, removed, local, desktop or historically unknown delivery targets.
persisted_records.target_contract: New removed/unknown writes fail; old removed targets remain list/edit/delete capable and execute as unsupported_delivery without network or reroute.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: explicit per-job edit/delete; preserve opaque target text during upgrade
known_gaps: Current DeliveryTarget.parse may silently map unknown targets to local.

persisted_records.sensitivity: conversation text, participant/channel identifiers and platform origin
persisted_records.observed_current: Session/channel recovery consumes stored platform origin values.
persisted_records.target_contract: Historical removed origins remain opaque history and never start a platform, send, or create a desktop Study binding.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: retain by default; explicit session deletion only
known_gaps: C07 upgrade tests must cover stale origin lookup and safe display fallback.

persisted_records.sensitivity: recipient ids and display names
persisted_records.observed_current: send-message lookup and session reconciliation may expose removed recipients.
persisted_records.target_contract: Removed recipients are displayable for cleanup/history but never eligible send targets.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: explicit entry deletion or compatibility retention
known_gaps: New-write preflight is deferred to CTL-C02.

persisted_records.sensitivity: external user ids, pairing codes/status and rate-limit state
persisted_records.observed_current: Rust and core discover arbitrary platform filenames.
persisted_records.target_contract: Only retained ids can create/update pairing records; removed records remain explicit cleanup candidates without child/network effects.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: per-platform explicit cleanup
known_gaps: Filename discovery is not yet constrained by the product manifest.

persisted_records.path_or_record: profile gateway_state.json, gateway.pid, gateway.lock and cron/.tick.lock
persisted_records.sensitivity: process ids, platform/profile status and locks
persisted_records.observed_current: Rust supervisor reads/removes these files during lifecycle operations.
persisted_records.target_contract: Removed credentials cannot recreate runtime files; stale files are not platform eligibility evidence.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: bounded lifecycle cleanup inside a resolved retained profile
known_gaps: Current global eligibility can be influenced by removed credentials.

persisted_records.sensitivity: message attachments and derived media
persisted_records.observed_current: Neutral gateway base helpers share these caches across platforms.
persisted_records.target_contract: Retain neutral caches/contracts; platform deletion must not delete user media automatically.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: existing bounded cache policy or explicit user cleanup
known_gaps: Discord tests currently carry some neutral media coverage that must move before adapter removal.

persisted_records.sensitivity: channel/thread identifiers
persisted_records.observed_current: ThreadMapStore constructs filenames from the active platform name.
persisted_records.target_contract: Only retained platforms create/update maps; removed maps are compatibility data only.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: explicit per-platform cleanup
known_gaps: Dynamic plugin platform names can currently create additional filenames.

persisted_records.sensitivity: bot token, context tokens, account identity and sync cursor
persisted_records.observed_current: Weixin adapter stores credentials and resume state under its account directory.
persisted_records.target_contract: Retain only for mainland Weixin with bounded account ids; reconcile plaintext secret storage with the desktop secret contract.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: explicit per-account sign-out/clear with no recursive home deletion
known_gaps: bot_token and context tokens currently live outside Windows Credential Manager.

persisted_records.sensitivity: pairing progress, temporary tokens and account identifiers
persisted_records.observed_current: Python QR workers write and Tauri commands read these files.
persisted_records.target_contract: Retain only for mainland Weixin/QQ Bot; clear bounded temporary files after terminal state.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: worker-owned exact-file replacement/deletion

persisted_records.sensitivity: removed-platform pairing progress and credentials
persisted_records.observed_current: Python/Rust/Web removed-platform QR producers remain live.
persisted_records.target_contract: Stop producing at CTL-C02, remove commands/workers later, retain stale files only for explicit cleanup.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: explicit exact-file cleanup after user confirmation
known_gaps: Current Settings/onboarding can still invoke removed QR flows.

persisted_records.sensitivity: message ids, external identities, rules and pairing state
persisted_records.observed_current: Feishu adapter/comment subsystems read and write these files.
persisted_records.target_contract: No live producer/consumer after Feishu removal; old files remain explicit cleanup/export candidates.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: explicit exact-file cleanup
known_gaps: Comment subsystem is a separate removal edge from the primary adapter.

persisted_records.sensitivity: Telegram sticker ids and local cache metadata
persisted_records.observed_current: Retained Telegram adapter imports the shared sticker cache module.
persisted_records.target_contract: Retain only for SEA Telegram and preserve bounded cache behavior.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: cache-owned bounded cleanup
known_gaps: Telegram dependency/runtime is currently absent from desktop.

persisted_records.sensitivity: WhatsApp private auth state, keys and LID mappings
persisted_records.observed_current: Adapter and identity reader accept canonical/legacy paths; the Node bridge has an additional HOME fallback.
persisted_records.target_contract: One profile-scoped SEA canonical directory with explicit legacy reader/migration and no runtime network install.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: explicit sign-out/clear of both canonical and legacy paths after resolution checks
known_gaps: Adapter, identity reader and bridge currently disagree on canonical paths.

persisted_records.path_or_record: platforms/whatsapp/bridge.log and legacy HOME/.hermes image/document/audio caches
persisted_records.sensitivity: transport logs and message attachments
persisted_records.observed_current: Bridge logging/cache behavior can escape the intended profile root through HOME fallbacks.
persisted_records.target_contract: All bridge output remains under the resolved WhatsApp profile with bounded logs/caches.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: bounded cache/log cleanup; never delete an unresolved HOME tree
known_gaps: Bridge HOME fallback may resolve inconsistently, including a literal tilde path.

persisted_records.sensitivity: desktop conversations, learning state and delivery projection
persisted_records.observed_current: Desktop shell/service owns these databases independently of gateway profile files.
persisted_records.target_contract: Platform pruning must not reinterpret or delete desktop records; removed gateway projections become honest unavailable/history states.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: database-owned migrations and explicit product deletion only
known_gaps: Desktop is a product shell, not Platform.LOCAL or a fallback target.

persisted_records.path_or_record: Windows Credential Manager entries for LLM/provider secrets
persisted_records.sensitivity: provider API secrets
persisted_records.observed_current: Tauri bridge retrieves provider keys; gateway platform secrets still use .env/profile files.
persisted_records.target_contract: Never recursively clear the vault; removed gateway cleanup is exact-key and does not touch provider secrets.
persisted_records.cleanup_mode: exact credential target/key deletion after explicit user action
known_gaps: Gateway credentials do not yet share the LLM secret-vault path.
